entries.note_hr: Put Malog Princa u NP Paklenica zatvoren je do daljnjeg zbog dotrajalih elemenata osiguranja i pomagala u prolasku zahtjevnoga planinarskog puta.
entries.note_en: Put Malog Princa in NP Paklenica is closed until further notice due to worn safety elements and aids on this demanding trail.

entries.note_hr: U NP Risnjak od 26. lipnja 2026. zatvara se planinarski ulaz Vilje te planinarska staza Vilje - Risnjak (dio staze 108).
entries.note_en: In NP Risnjak, the Vilje mountain entrance and the Vilje - Risnjak trail (part of trail 108) are closed from 26 June 2026.

entries.note_hr: Ponegdje su mogući izraženi pljuskovi s grmljavinom, mjestimice mogu biti i obilni. Vjerojatnost grmljavine > 70 % (Gospićka regija / Lika / Velebit).
entries.note_en: Locally severe showers with thunderstorms are possible, locally heavy. Thunderstorm probability > 70% (Gospić region / Lika / Velebit).
entries.gear: Rain gear, avoid exposed ridgelines and summits during afternoon and evening hours

entries.note_hr: Mjestimice izraženi pljuskovi s grmljavinom, a navečer su moguća i grmljavinska nevremena. Vjerojatnost grmljavine > 70 %. BUDITE SPREMNI na jača grmljavinska nevremena koja mogu prouzročiti veliku štetu (Riječka regija / Kvarner / Gorski kotar / Risnjak / Učka).
entries.note_en: Locally severe showers with thunderstorms, and in the evening severe thunderstorm events are possible. Thunderstorm probability > 70%. BE PREPARED for stronger thunderstorm events that may cause significant damage (Rijeka region / Kvarner / Gorski kotar / Risnjak / Učka).
entries.gear: Rain gear, waterproof layer; avoid exposed ridgelines, summits and forest edges; seek shelter before evening

entries.note_hr: Olujni udari jugozapadnog vjetra. Najjači udari vjetra > 65 km/h (Riječka regija / Kvarner / Gorski kotar / Risnjak / Učka).
entries.note_en: Storm gusts of SW wind. Strongest wind gusts > 65 km/h (Rijeka region / Kvarner / Gorski kotar / Risnjak / Učka).
entries.gear: Secure all loose equipment; avoid exposed ridgelines and summits 17:00-21:00

entries.note_hr: Mjestimice jak jugozapadni i sjeverozapadni vjetar. Najjači udari vjetra 35-45 čvorova (65-85 km/h) (Sjeverna Dalmacija / Paklenica / velebitska obala).
entries.note_en: Locally strong SW and NW wind. Strongest wind gusts 35-45 knots (65-85 km/h) (Northern Dalmatia / Paklenica / Velebit coastal).
entries.gear: Secure all loose equipment; avoid exposed coastal and ridge positions 17:00-20:00

entries.note_hr: Uz nestabilnosti olujni udari sjeverozapadnog vjetra. Najjači udari vjetra > 65 km/h (Splitska regija / Biokovo).
entries.note_en: Storm gusts of NW wind alongside atmospheric instabilities. Strongest wind gusts > 65 km/h (Split region / Biokovo).
entries.gear: Rain gear; avoid exposed Biokovo ridgeline and summits from 19:00 onward

entries.note_hr: Ograničenje kretanja na Omiškoj Dinari nakon požara.
entries.note_en: Movement restrictions on Omiška Dinara following a wildfire.

entries.note_hr: Planinarski dom Alan od 19. rujna 2025. ponovno pruža mogućnost noćenja. Kuća i dalje nudi usluge prehrane (po dogovoru) kao i ponudu pića, napitaka i opskrbu vodom.
entries.note_en: Mountain hut Alan has resumed overnight accommodation from 19 September 2025. The hut continues to offer meals (by arrangement) as well as drinks, beverages and water supply.
